**Implementation note:** Buy-side skew only: sell rungs cannot move below cost.

## Description

Adjusts bid/ask quote prices and sizes based on inventory so the strategy encourages trades that reduce unwanted exposure.

## Where it may fit

Two-sided markets where spread capture is possible but inventory can accumulate; stronger with robust fair-value estimates.

## Vehicles

Electronic market-making and liquidity-provider books.

## Required data

L2 quotes, trades, mid/fair-value estimate, current inventory, volatility, fee schedule and order queue state.

## Caveats

Quote skew is model-dependent; inventory limits, adverse selection, stale-data detection and queue-position modeling are essential.
